text: You have about ten seconds. Use them. You just stepped into space. No suit. But you don't explode.
Space is basically a giant thermos. The spit on your tongue, though? That boils.
In 1966, a NASA test volunteer felt it bubbling...
Because about ten seconds in, your brain runs out of oxygen. Lights out. That volunteer?
They pumped the air back in, in under ninety seconds. He woke up fine. Subscribe for more.
